cases: both independently authored schemas validate through public data-dict
plain R resolves shared sample values without a chat
changed or missing bound fields fail rather than repairing the mapping
release references are scalar and assertion identities are unique
relationship terms cannot be used as concept bindings
vocabulary release and content mismatch fail independently
a changed dictionary is rejected before binding validation
a repinned renamed dictionary still requires a new binding
unexpected qualifier fields are rejected rather than silently dropped
machine and prose records preserve exact direction and all qualifiers
shared terms do not establish safe comparisons or joins
a new release renames a field while the earlier release replays exactly
Commons public constructors consume the same context and local dictionaries
limitations: Constructor consumption only; Commons model/tool roundtrip belongs to #62.
Spec/binding/import-field checks are not full data-value validation.
Comparison guard is deliberately narrow; no conversion, join planner, reasoner or authorization proof.
